question.text: A charge particle of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μC</mi></math> accelerated by a potential difference of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> enters a region of uniform magnetic field of magnitude <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mT</mi></math> at right angle to the direction of field. The charge particle completes semicircle of radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> inside magnetic field. The mass of the charge particle is ______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>18</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math>.

solution.text:
As we know, radius of the circular path is given by,

r=mvqB=2mKqB=2×m×qVqB

⇒r2=2mVqB2

⇒m=r2qB22V=3×10-22×2×10-6×4×10-322×100=144×10-18 kg
